bolt_group_capacity.acceptance_evidence: Fastener specification, torque record and static/fatigue load result.
bolt_group_capacity.bench_method: Confirm the installed bolt stack, then load the root interface in the documented worst-case direction.

drivetrain_efficiency.acceptance_evidence: Efficiency versus load trace with the fitted gear pair installed.
drivetrain_efficiency.bench_method: Compare calibrated motor input torque with output torque at the spool under representative low-speed load.

dynamic_root_load.acceptance_evidence: Peak root force and moment traces linked to the motion profile.
dynamic_root_load.bench_method: Run constrained low-speed and start-stop motions with a root load cell or strain-gauged fixture.

low_speed_full_travel_current.acceptance_evidence: Time-aligned current, voltage and temperature log for all three routes.
low_speed_full_travel_current.bench_method: Log each C610 current and temperature through complete low-speed payout and take-up cycles.

seal_drag.acceptance_evidence: Torque trace, leakage observation and test duration for both media.
seal_drag.bench_method: Measure breakaway and running torque of the completed shaft, seal and labyrinth assembly dry and submerged.

spool_usable_turns.acceptance_evidence: Video or photographs plus turn count and layered-radius measurement for each spool.
spool_usable_turns.bench_method: Wind the production tendon across the full spool width and count stable turns before flange contact or cross-over instability.

tendon_friction.acceptance_evidence: Per-route friction ratio, sliding observation, slack and rebound record.
tendon_friction.bench_method: Pull each actual tendon route at low speed through straight and bent arm states while measuring both-end tension.

wet_mass_and_buoyancy.acceptance_evidence: Recorded mass, displacement and residual buoyancy for each medium.
wet_mass_and_buoyancy.bench_method: Weigh the fully assembled dry and flooded machine, then measure displaced volume in fresh and salt water.
